functionalRequirement: System shall show the first lines of news articles based on the titles on the title screen.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must display the first lines of news articles for 100% of the titles shown on the title screen.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to consistently show the first lines of news articles based on their titles.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must load and display the first lines of news articles within 500 milliseconds for up to 100 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for quick loading times to ensure a smooth user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and consistent layout for displaying the first lines of news articles, ensuring readability across all devices.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves displaying content to users, necessitating an easy-to-use and consistent interface.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to create a Gmail account by providing personal details like name, gender, password, mobile number, and location.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must validate all provided personal details (e.g., name, password, mobile number) according to Gmail's validation rules with 100% accuracy.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires accurate validation of user-provided data to ensure account creation integrity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all personal details using AES-256 during transmission and storage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling sensitive personal data, necessitating strong encryption.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide real-time feedback and error messages for invalid inputs during account creation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires user interaction, necessitating mechanisms to prevent and correct errors.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to import and manage various data formats like images, videos, and audio files within presentations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support importing and managing all specified data formats (images, videos, audio files) for 100% of supported use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive support for multiple data formats.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must import and display a 100 MB video file within 2 seconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling large files, requiring efficient processing times.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: The system must support importing files from at least three different file storage services (e.g., Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves importing files, necessitating compatibility with external services.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to set the price, quantity, upload pictures, and add details when listing an item.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must validate price and quantity inputs to ensure they are within acceptable ranges (e.g., positive numbers) with 100% accuracy.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires accurate validation of user inputs to ensure data integrity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive interface for uploading pictures and adding item details.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction, necessitating an easy-to-use interface.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that uploaded pictures and item details cannot be tampered with during transmission or storage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling user-generated content, necessitating data integrity.

functionalRequirement: Doctors shall be able to log in to check patient information, answer patient queries, perform daily activities, set reminders, and communicate with their staff.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support all specified functionalities (e.g., checking patient information, setting reminders) for 100% of logged-in doctors.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive support for all listed functionalities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) for doctor logins.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves accessing sensitive patient information, necessitating strong authentication.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available for doctor logins and functionalities for 99.99% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to critical functionalities, necessitating high availability.
